name: ship-pr-dev
title: Ship PR
description: Ship a verified PR from a branch or approved plan through one independent review, latest-SHA green CI and a report-only learning pass; never merge.
notes:
## What it does

Ship PR owns delivery from a local branch to a human-reviewable PR. The coordinator keeps architecture, Git, PR state, and final acceptance while bounded workers handle separable implementation, independent review, difficult CI diagnosis, and the final report-only learning pass.

## Credit routing

- Codex workers request gpt-5.6-luna with max effort and fresh self-contained context.
- Claude Code workers request claude-sonnet-5, normally at high effort when supported.
- OpenCode workers inherit the user's default model.
- Trivial implementation stays inline; review uses one isolated primary with no review subagents.
- Deterministic checks, Git, PR operations, and CI polling stay in the coordinator.

## Review ownership

Requires the review-code-dev v2 Alibaba delegation contract (tested with 2.0.0). The coordinator bootstraps OCR without additional LLM config, freezes scope and dispatches one isolated reviewer. Frontend and other focus areas stay in this review. Critical/high block readiness; medium requires a fix or explicit human acceptance. Coverage and source freshness must pass. No legacy specialist router or native fallback is assumed.

## Readiness

Ship PR never merges and never reports success until local evidence is fresh, review blockers are resolved, every visible non-skipped latest-SHA CI item is green, and capture-learning-tools completed report-only.

## Completion and persistence

Attempt counts trigger reassessment rather than automatic abandonment. Continue scoped repairs when new evidence supports a useful next step; stop for concrete access, external-state, or human-decision blockers. Local-only requests end with locally verified work and an explicit remote-CI limitation. Inspired by Eric Provencher’s article: https://x.com/pvncher/status/2095991462416490862.

changes: Include Skillpack activation reporting with optional identity, telemetry opt-out, and non-blocking delivery.
Clarify that critical UI validation requires an authorized runnable app or accessible preview; a disabled launch policy alone does not block optional visual validation.
Preserve required repository checks and report unavailable rendered evidence honestly.
Accept an optional approved plan handoff while preserving standalone branch and PR workflows.
Carry original need, plan criteria, approval and deviations into the single independent review gate.
Use repository validation and launch instructions, and report current UI evidence with shareable PR screenshots when feasible.
Use review-code-dev v2 Alibaba delegation with portable OCR setup and one isolated host reviewer.
Replace legacy modes, specialist routing and P0-only assumptions with explicit upstream severity, coverage and source-freshness handoff.
Require complete branch plus pending-workspace review and block on missing v2/OCR instead of silently using the old review.
Replace automatic retry-count stops with evidence-based reassessment and explicit completion criteria for remote and local-only delivery.
Centralize continuation and blocker decisions in readiness-gates.md while preserving review, CI, Git ownership, and worker concurrency safeguards.
Add regression scenarios for a justified fourth CI correction, unavailable external credentials, and local-only completion.
Ignore Python bytecode caches produced when bundled tests are imported by discovery-based runners.
Distinguish agent workflow packages from application code during impact classification.
Prevent skill-only Python and security references from escalating small PRs to backend or security review tiers.
Add regression coverage for skill-only and real application risk paths, without leaving Python cache artifacts.
Route Codex workers to gpt-5.6-luna/max, Claude Code workers to claude-sonnet-5, and leave OpenCode on its default model.
Add explicit trivial, standard, and deep agent budgets, single-writer ownership, fresh work orders, worker resume, and routing telemetry.
Remove the duplicate Ship PR review board and standalone frontend mega-pass; review-code-dev now owns one bounded review gate.
Add 10/25/50-minute local targets, non-blocking reassessment checkpoints, worker progress checks, and separate external-CI timing so small changes cannot silently drift for an hour.
Preserve the strict latest-SHA all-visible-CI gate and canonical capture-learning-tools handoff.
Last published Companion baseline before the credit-aware redesign.
Initial bounded PR delivery workflow.

commands.name: Ship branch as PR
commands.desc: Finish scoped work, verify, review, commit, push, create or update the PR, and wait for latest-SHA CI.

commands.name: Prepare local PR handoff
commands.desc: Run cleanup, verification, and review but stop before remote mutation.

commands.name: Update existing PR
commands.desc: Apply bounded fixes, refresh evidence, push, update the PR, and return CI to green.
